Parse local check selection independently of the shared xtask CLI.

Read shared local-check policy values without depending on check execution.

crate::check_source
Load declared Rust modules and preserve source locations for local checks.

crate::core_filters
Drop xtask-core findings that this workspace's policy exempts.

crate::effect_writes
Keep Signal and Var writes out of framework effect closures.

crate::element_shadow
Forbid inherent methods that shadow Element methods on element types.

crate::hand_element
Allow hand-written Element and IntoView impls only in the core view module.

crate::impl_model
Enforce the engine's declared Model processing modules syntactically.

crate::interaction_view
Keep views out of kivact-interaction except an Api `surface` (design 6.3).

crate::kit_literal_color
Keep kit literal color construction in the designated palette files.

children.label:
crate::local_checks
Run the workspace's local architectural checks under shared selectors.

crate::macros
Find the workspace's `macro_rules!` and every path that invokes them.

crate::module_rules
Check the direction of module references inside a crate (`[module_rules]`).

crate::name_collision
Keep kit public names distinct from core and standard prelude names.

crate::os_branch
Reject operating-system branches outside declared platform boundaries.

crate::pending
Read the rework pending table: rules that only print in listed packages.

crate::policy
Splits [module_rules] off the policy and writes the core policy xtask reads.

crate::public_surface
Resolve public reexports to definition identities for API checks.

crate::public_type_edges
Build finite API type dependencies from exposed Rust type positions.

crate::report
Print the collected workspace check result and choose its exit code.

Find mutated types and functions that hold two or more state fields or locals.

children.label:
crate::state::check
Report mutated types and functions that combine state without a closing marker.

crate::state::fields
Classify one field type as plain state, interior state, a handle or nothing.

crate::state::index
Index which types of each package their own methods mutate after construction.

crate::state::locals
Find functions that keep two or more state locals.

crate::ui_machine
Keep input-driven Machines and signal-writing effects out of kivact-ui.

crate::unit_machine
Forbid Machines without state: `machine(())` and `type State = ()`.
